node.title: WCL slot 1,6 emptiness
node.statement: No reduced signed weight-6 polynomial vanishes at an order-512 root at any official row (ell=1 window; (1,6)-shaped relations exist at NON-ambient primes — the v_2(q-1) >= 41 gate is load-bearing). Exact search excludes all relations on the first 64 certified split-prime characteristics q=k*2^41+1 with 3<=k<=996 and on 128 generated extension rows: 64 exact-v2(p-1)=39 degree-four rows and 64 exact-v2(p-1)=40 degree-two rows. This finite evidence does not cover later characteristics or nonsplit-on-mu_512 extension classes. The exact unsigned sign-product router aggregates the 32 sign lifts into 11,650,060 affine-Galois orbits in two product-parity sectors. Its pair-Heron and parity-adapted refinements descend to base-field factors. All-one-parity supports route exactly to lower conductor, while every mixed-parity Heron or quadratic block norm contains the complete signed norm of each class it owns; cross-pairing block gcds therefore do not compress the individual obstruction. Compatible-prime control remains open. FALSIFIER: one official-admissible generated field (q < 2^256, v_2(q-1) >= 41) carrying the vanisher. Minted 2026-07-19 at the WCL amber ceremony; bookkeeping of record = the zone node's official_terminal_attack.md.
